## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what a user or maintainer can do after this change.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Explain any skipped checks. For export/layout changes, include results from the downloaded artifact and its target reader where available.

## Compatibility and provenance

- Does this change permissions, network behavior, saved data, backup schemas, or internal identifiers?
- Does it add a dependency, copied code, font, image, or other asset? If so, identify its source and license.

## Submission check

- [ ] The patch is focused and preserves existing user data.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or validation gaps are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation describes any changed user-visible behavior or privacy boundary.
- [ ] No credentials, private documents, browser profiles, or personal-storage snapshots are included.
- [ ] I am authorized to contribute the code and assets under the applicable licenses.
